purpose: Record the Operator's confirmed decision about which origins may contribute to one derived measure and record type on an inclusive range of local dates, as one append-only pending Source Selection Policy through the operational-store@5 operations. The unit owns the closed vocabulary of derived measures, offers the known origins and the live policies to choose among, previews which live policies a request replaces and which dates it leaves without a policy, and records the request only while the live policies still match what the Operator confirmed. The pending policy is itself the durable request to rebuild the affected summaries; activation, rebuilding, and Cutover Records belong to later units.

inputs.name: selection_request
inputs.description: The Operator's request: a derived measure, its record type, one or more origins as operational-store@5 OriginKey values, and optional inclusive first and last local dates, where an absent bound is open.

inputs.name: confirmed_supersession
inputs.description: The identities of the live Source Selection Policies the Operator saw in the preview and confirmed the request replaces; empty when it replaces none.

inputs.name: measure_vocabulary
inputs.description: This unit's closed vocabulary of derived measures, each with the record types it may name: daily-steps with steps, heart-rate-summary with heart-rate, sleep-summary with sleep-session, and weight-series with weight.

inputs.name: operational_store
inputs.description: The Operational Store through operational-store@5: known_origins and source_selection_timeline read in one read view, and one record_source_selection_policy write.

inputs.name: clock
inputs.description: The caller's timezone-aware Portal time source, read at most once per request, immediately before the write.

inputs.name: free_space
inputs.description: Free bytes on the store's filesystem, which the store compares with its reserve before the policy write.

outputs.name: selection_choices
outputs.description: For one measure and record type: the known origins of that record type, each with its source-system kind, origin, and Source Record count, and the live Source Selection Policies in date order. No Source Identity, record time, or value.

outputs.name: selection_preview
outputs.description: For one request, without writing: the request with its origins sorted; the live policy it repeats, if one is identical; the live policies of the same measure and record type it would supersede, ascending; and the date ranges those policies cover that the request would leave without a policy.

outputs.name: recorded_policy
outputs.description: The pending operational-store@5 SourceSelectionPolicyRecord recorded or repeated; whether this call took the write path, which is also the case when an identical request recorded the same policy between this call's read and its write; and the date ranges left without a policy by its supersession.

outputs.name: selection_refusal
outputs.description: A refusal carrying one of this unit's names and nothing else: selection-request-invalid, selection-measure-unknown, selection-origin-unknown, or selection-changed. Nothing is written.

outputs.name: store_failure
outputs.description: The store's timestamp-invalid refusal, or its store-busy or storage-reserve-exhausted retryable failure, passed through unchanged; it carries only the failure name. A failure raised before the store's write commits, including one from a read, leaves nothing written. A failure raised after the write commits, while delivering the result, leaves the policy committed, and a retry of the same request is then a repeat.

observable_effects.name: source-selection-policy-write
observable_effects.description: One pending Source Selection Policy appended through operational-store@5's record_source_selection_policy, superseding exactly the live policies of the same measure and record type whose dates it shares; a request identical to a live policy writes nothing, a store failure before commit writes nothing, and a failure after commit leaves the policy committed. No Processing Job, summary work, or activation is written.

owns: the closed vocabulary of derived measures for Source Selection Policies and the record type each may name
the Operator's choices for one measure: the known origins of its record type and the live policies
computing which live policies a request supersedes and which dates it leaves without a policy
checking that the supersession the Operator confirmed still matches the live policies before recording
recognizing a request identical to a live policy, and recording any other valid request as one pending Source Selection Policy
does_not_own: policy storage, identities, the overlap and supersession invariants, known-origin evidence, or the storage reserve, which operational-store@5 owns
the confirmation page, its form and CSRF protection, or rendering origins and policies, which the Phase 7 Portal presentation units own
Summary Refresh Jobs, Cutover Targets, Candidate Builds, Cutover Records, policy activation, or the active timeline, which operational-store@6 and refresh-summary-state own
how a Health Summary applies a policy, when overlapping origins leave a result unresolved, or Duplicate Groups, which summary-contract, duplicate-observation-contract, and the derive units own
Fallback Timezone Policies, which set-fallback-timezone-policy owns
withdrawing a policy without a replacement, or erasing policies under privacy deletion
